notes.title: Evil Lawyer: Alexander Twist now available on Steam!
notes.content:
My new game, Evil Lawyer: Alexander Twist, is now on Steam! If you enjoy court action, murder mysteries, cute hamsters or any of the absolutely insane stuff that happened in How Stories Die, check it out!

Wishlist now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938840/Evil_Lawyer_Alexander_Twist/]Steam Page[/url]

Keep up with updates: [url=https://discord.gg/dRKjVdA]Official Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36401558/8e7f4461927c7ed0b1c6bbf5b1bf53b6c9fad3c4.png[/img]

In a world where criminals possess superpowers, radical changes to the law must be made. Employing the concept of "Guilty until proven innocent", the world of crime only hope was Alexander Twist, a rising star that excels in quick thinking, deduction and cheating.

Riding on the waves of victory, Alexander enjoyed the rotten fruits of his success... until one person said, enough. Framed for the arson of his own apartment, Alexander and his four hamsters must now battle against the entire law system. The shrewd lawyer will have to use every trick up his sleeve to escape the looming sentence, not knowing success means a much, [b]much [/b]worse fate....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36401558/552e115a20d1321bea1fcafdf99666e458d0cd7f.png[/img]
[list]

[*] [b]Build Your Case:[/b] Supernatural murders require a perceptive eye. Investigate and gather clues at the scene using point & click, and make sure to beware the traps laid by the culprit.

[*][b] A Trial By Wit:[/b] Dominate the battlefield in an Ace Attorney style. Find weak spots in arguments and present the evidence in flashy Objection! moments. Don't be distracted by the chaos though, a culprit's ploy might have multiple layers of mystery.

[*] [b]Always Fresh:[/b] Try your hand at over seven mind-boggling trials, each testing your creativity and deduction ability to the limit. From Umineko to Agatha Christie to a Werewolf game, every trial has its own unique style!

[*][b] A Web of Lies: [/b]Past and present collide in a thrilling, multi-protagonist plot that will always keep you on your toes. Over 25 hours of heart-throbbing mystery guaranteed!

[*] [b]Winning Is Everything:[/b] Use your defensive and offensive lawyer skills to turn the tide of the battle. From Alexander's evil tricks to Elena's burning pressure, both sides will use everything in their disposal to win.

[*] [b]Can You Untangle The Web?:[/b] Alexander Twist is a supernatural detective visual novel with gameplay inspired by Ace Attorney and Danganronpa. However, logic, deduction and creativity skills won't be enough to untangle the web. What are you willing to risk in order to come out on top?

[/list]

notes.title: New game announced: Evil Lawyer Alexander Twist!
notes.content:
The game is in the mystery/supernatural genre, set in Paris in the 1960s. It will have a system similar to Ace Attorney in the sense that you choose an evidence to counter someone's argument, but, and that's a big but, instead of just finding holes in the witnesses' testimony, ANY sentence can be objected(with varying effectiveness, of course), so you will have to be on your tows the whole trial.

The synopsis of the story: Following a mysterious plague in the 1940s, 40% of the humans on earth acquired a superpower. To combat the chaos and the new "superpowered criminals" the law system had to go under heavy reform, now adopting the principle of "Guilty until proven innocent" alongside heavy bias of the judges toward the prosecution. As a result, almost every single case ends in a guilty verdict. 

Only one person in Paris manages to combat the unfair law system with his intelligence, cheating, and four hamster companions: Alexander Twist. He was riding on the waves on success until he was found himself in a cell, framed for arson and murder. He must now turn this unlucky situation on its head and beat the opposing prosecutor, Elena Waddington, at her own game. But if he succeeds, a fate far worse than 25 years in jail awaits him...

Here is one of the hamsters, Cupcake the gluttonous and dim-witted hamster:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36401558/e6cf65cc8486c96e80743a1e363e99ace2f3c0e6.png[/img] 

The game will be divided to 5 chapters and feature 2 protagonists(Alexander and Elena), with each chapter containing a challenging trial. Prepare to some crazy and creative crimes!

You can join the discord here to follow the game's development and be notified when content is being released!

https://discord.gg/dRKjVdA

notes.title: A final release date and another important announcement.
notes.content:
Hey, so due to personal reasons the release will be postponed to October. I am really sorry about it, but I don't want to give out a rushed product, I hope you understand. 

Also, I noticed that I am not being very transparent with you guys(as you can see with the amount of updates I've been posting), and I want to be more in touch with you. I would be really happy if you could hit up my discord server, I just opened it.

You can ask any questions you would like there, plus I will do my best to post some funny content that will also expand the lore a little bit and give insight into the daily lives of the characters(like the one below).

Link for discord: https://discord.gg/dRKjVdA (it may be small now, but I intend to play the long game).

An important note: Although that up until now I didn't post a lot of updates, I am working steadily on the game everyday. It's in good hands.

notes.title: Partial OST, Spanish translation and release delay
notes.content:
Hello there! There will be a partial OST for the game made by Alex Shea including themes for Nozomi and Haruka(with a few versions, but telling you what they are will be spoilers).

I am collaborating with Spanish translation group gamer japones, so the game will also be available in Spanish(not at release, give them time).

The bad news are that the game will be delayed in 4 months(who knew that a degree in software engineering will take so much of your time?), I will do my best to finish it by then.
